scope: Finite diagnostics and exact coverage accounting. No smaller machine, semantic lower bound, or new kernel equivalence theorem is claimed.

two_incoming_full_action.domain: Delete one eligible nonprotected state with two external incoming rows; independently choose write, direction, and surviving target or halt at each incoming row; preserve all other retained rows.
two_incoming_full_action.fresh_contract: Canonical logical successor and register effect, full exterior/frame, arbitrary output gap >= 40; 1000 affine-rule fuel.
two_incoming_full_action.archival_contract: Exact successor frame with original affine gap; 1000 affine-rule fuel.
two_incoming_full_action.combined_claim: All 46,738,944 recipes fail the exact finite source-50 contract. The 36 fresh domains additionally fail the weaker output-gap contract. The ten archived complete domains were not rerun under the weaker contract.
two_incoming_full_action.independent_audit: Replays every fresh lazy branch, weighted pruning subtree, and final frontier; does not independently rerun each affine failure.
two_incoming_full_action.audit_repair: State 215 initially had an incomplete journal tail (10,810 lines versus 11,089 reported nodes). The entire domain was rerun; the replacement 11,089-line journal passed the independent audit. This repeated domain contributes no additional unique coverage.

uniform_deletion_contracts.overlap_note: These are the same 55,471 concrete uniform recipes under five different sufficient contracts; counts must not be added as unique recipes.

protected_box_mixed_rows.caveat: The altered Box routines were sampled, not proved for arbitrary registers. Their conditional affine screen nevertheless yielded no survivor.

across_family_overlap: The full-action, uniform-fold, and mixed-row families may intersect. No overall unique recipe total across these families is asserted.
